name: Sacramento (United States)

colors.symbolism: the upper-hoist field — the American River
the lower-fly field — the Sacramento River
the sweeping S-curve and the lettering
the half-disc at the upper hoist
the gold half-disc at the fly

description: A broad white S-curve sweeps between a blue upper-hoist field and a darker blue lower-fly field, with a green half-disc at the upper edge, a gold half-disc at the fly, and CITY OF SACRAMENTO in white capitals along the bottom.
history: Used by the City of Sacramento, the capital of California since 1854, founded at the confluence of the Sacramento and American Rivers in 1849 during the California Gold Rush.

features.role: white S-curve dividing two blues, with green and gold half-discs
